entity_collision_grid.option.enabled.too: Answer entity collision / pushing / cramming queries from a spatial hash grid instead of scanning whole chunk sections. Results are identical to vanilla.
entity_collision_grid.option.cell_size.t: Size of one grid cell in blocks. Smaller cells = fewer candidates per query but more bookkeeping for big entities. 2 is a good default.
entity_collision_grid.option.debug_log.t: Periodically logs how many entity checks vanilla would do vs. how many the grid does (also runs a synthetic benchmark at startup).
entity_collision_grid.option.debug_verif: Runs the vanilla query as well and warns if the results differ. Slow - for testing only.
